out_items.name: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated

violations.title: Package Integrity
violations.observation: The following food item from damaged packaging were found offered for sale or service: SEVERAL CANNED GOODS OBSERVED WITH SIGNIFICANT DENT ON SEAMS.
violations.corrective_action: Food packages such as canned goods shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the food is not exposed to adulteration or potential contaminants. Return all dented and damaged canned goods to your food supplier for a credit. EHS INFORMED CFM THAT ANY RECEIVED CANS WITH NOTICEABLE/SIGNIFICANT DENTS SHOULD BE RETURNED OR REJECTED TO SUPPLIER AND NOT USED FOR SERVICE. IL CREATION CAFE (Inspection Date: 08/26/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the SANITIZER BUCKET CLOSEST TO COOKLINE with a concentration of 0ppm total quaternary ammonium compound.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. EHS ASSISTED IN BRINGING ANOTHER SANITIZER BUCKET WITH 200-400PPM QUATERNARY AMMONIA CONCENTRATION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: MILK AT 50F, CARROT CAKE AT 50F IN TO-GO COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM DISCARDED FOOD.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restriction & Storage; Medicines Location
violations.observation: Employees' medicines are not properly located to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE MEDICINE STORED ON SHELF NEXT TO SPICES ACROSS FROM OVEN.
violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. EMPLOYEE REMOVED MEDICINE AND STORED IN PERSONAL BELONGINGS.

violations.title: Raw Produce Washed before Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED EMPLOYEE CUT LETTUCE BEFORE WASHING.
violations.corrective_action: Raw vegetables shall be thoroughly washed in water to remove soil and other contaminants before being cut, combined with other ingredients, cooked, served, or offered for human consumption in a ready-to-eat form. EHS INFORMED CFM THAT RAW PRODUCE SHOULD BE WASHED BEFORE CUTTING.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not designed or constructed to be easily cleanable: MILK CRATES USED TO STORE PAPER GOODS, FOOD AND CLEANERS OFF OF FLOOR, UNTREATED WOOD BLOCKS USED TO ELEVATE ICE MACHINE OFF FLOOR, CARDBOARD UNDERNEATH FRYER USED TO ABSORB OIL.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces shall be free of unnecessary ledges, projections, and crevices, and designed and constructed to allow easy cleaning and to facilitate maintenance. CFM WILL DISCONTINUE USE TO MILK CRATES. CARDBOARD WILL BE CHANGED MORE FREQUENTLY.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: milk at coffee station.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. CFM marked milk with 4 hour end point of 11AM.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. Observed accumulation of growth on interior baffle of ice machine in back of kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. CFM will clean and sanitize baffle/interior of ice machine.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: salt, pepper, hot sauce for customer use at pizza station.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM will label containers with food name. IL CREATION CAFE (Inspection Date: 06/23/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. Observed unapproved backflow prevention device installed on mop faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS provided approved backflow prevention device product information to CFM. EHS will follow up in 3 days to ensure approved device has been purchased.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: yogurt (48°F) and cottage cheese (48°F) on salad bar area
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. FOODS DISCARD AT 11am.
